title: Embodied-VGGT: Preserving Reliable Local Geometry for Long-Sequence Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2611.33964v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long sequence reconstruction must correct accumulated drift while preserving locally consistent geometry. In robotics and autonomous driving, embodied acquisition provides recurring platform- environment geometry and repeated observations of scene structure and platform motion. We present Embodied-VGGT, which exploits these cues to establish reliable local relationships and selectively preserve them during global refinement. Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks (MAGC) builds on Scal3R's global context memory and uses relative scale references derived from predicted ground geometry to regularize test-time memory updates, encouraging cross-chunk consistency while limiting changes to reliable local geometry. Superpoint Alignment (SA) and Cross-Loop Optimization (CL) jointly address the robust establishment and preservation of geometric relationships. translated_title: 具身-VGGT：在长序列重建中保留可靠的局部几何
translated_abstract: 长序列重建需要在修正累积漂移的同时保持局部一致的几何结构。在机器人与自动驾驶领域，具身式采集能够提供重复出现的平台-环境几何关系，以及对场景结构和平台运动的反复观测。我们提出Embodied-VGGT，利用这些线索建立可靠的局部关系，并在全局优化过程中有选择地保留它们。记忆增强接地块（Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks, MAGC）构建于Scal3R的全局上下文记忆之上，利用由预测地面几何导出的相对尺度参考来规范测试时的记忆更新，在促进跨块一致性的同时限制对可靠局部几何的改变。超点对齐（Superpoint Alignment, SA）与跨环优化（Cross-Loop Optimization, CL）共同解决几何关系的鲁棒建立与保持问题。SA在空间区域之间平衡地面与非地面证据，以估计块间……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Embodied-VGGT利用具身采集提供的地面几何相对尺度参考与重复观测线索，通过记忆增强接地块（MAGC）、超点对齐（SA）与跨环优化（CL）三项技术，在长序列重建中同时修正累积漂移并可靠地保留局部一致的几何结构。
en_tdlr: Embodied-VGGT exploits embodied cues such as ground-derived relative scale references and repeated observations, combining Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks (MAGC), Superpoint Alignment (SA), and Cross-Loop Optimization (CL) to correct accumulated drift while reliably preserving locally consistent geometry in long-sequence reconstruction.
